description: A ground-level photograph illustrating the land cover category "Green urban areas" in Täby, Sweden. The image shows a spacious grassy foreground with scattered white rocks, indicating a semi-natural or informally managed green space. Several mature trees, including pines and birches, are prominent. In the mid-ground and background, multiple multi-story buildings, appearing to be residential or institutional, are visible. This photograph serves as a visual example for land cover classification, differentiating "Green urban areas" from other categories like "Urban fabric" or "Industrial, commercial and military units" within Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) and CORINE Land Cover (CLC+) nomenclature guidelines. The image credit is K. Larsson.
